good_thing: (Aliquippa, Pennsylvania): Nineteen dogs rescued from an alleged dogfighting operation are now legally in the Beaver County Humane Society’s custody and can begin moving toward permanent homes. Eight have already been placed with their foster families, and other dogs are being prepared for adoption. The shelter is also offering adopters complimentary training.
current_or_history: On November 22, 1880, Helen Louise Leonard made her New York debut at Tony Pastor’s Theatre under the name Lillian Russell. Within weeks, she had a prominent role in a comic version of The Pirates of Penzance and became an instant star of American musical theater.
tiny_fact: Aye-ayes, the lemurs of Madagascar, have a small extra digit on each hand: a pseudothumb with its own fingerprint. It appears to help them grip branches and objects.
thought: You do not have to make the whole day meaningful for one small good thing to count.
